entries.d150cb16eb29b926: The majority of revenue is 'revenue from contracts with customers' arising from buying and selling and manufacturing and sales of products and from the provision of services (¥10,432,460 million of total revenue of ¥13,995,222 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026). The remainder includes revenue related to leasing business and revenue related to financial instruments. By segment, revenue is largest in Living Industries, followed by Energy and Chemicals.
entries.d57fb4054ed02dec: In addition to buying and selling products such as metal resources, energy, chemicals and food, which connect sellers with buyers, the company builds resource and infrastructure development projects, invests in businesses, and earns profit while also being involved in the management of its investees. The securities report explains that the company, a [[term:sogo-shosha|general trading company]], centers on its global network of business sites and its information capabilities to conduct a diversified range of activities, including buying and selling, manufacturing, transport and financing of a wide variety of products.
entries.d835c384889ec28b: Gross profit, which is revenue less cost of sales, was ¥1,328,153 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026 (revenue in the same year was ¥13,995,222 million). Trading company revenue includes the cost of purchased goods as it is, so revenue size and profit size need to be viewed as different things. After deducting expenses and adding items such as the share of profit of investments accounted for using the equity method of ¥447,442 million, which reflects the profit and loss of investees, profit for the period attributable to owners of the parent was ¥833,971 million. By segment, profit for the period is largest in metal resources, which does not match the order of revenue.
